_doc: Global IndexTTS2 knobs for foreign-language MOVIE dubs (one file, own cast). No per-speaker entries: each movie has its own Phase A profile (spkNN), so no shared speaker map applies. These globals are the production-proven quality fixes from The Beast (2024): temperature/seed + max_text_tokens stop mid-sentence voice swaps; match_source scales each dubbed line to the RMS of the original line it replaces (keeps the mix's dynamics; whole-track loudnorm stays off). Shared by every movie in dub_foreign_movies.ps1.
